item.description: Extreme range testing! And extreme patience testing courtesy of Caco, with a dash of bladder testing??? Caco, Jack, and Earl find themselves in another extremely long drive. In one day, the trio will traverse the full extent of NLEX, TPLEX, Skyway Stage 1 2 and 3, SLEX, and finally STAR tollway in order to really test the 2026 MG HS Hybrid+, and their bladders with an ultra special challenge. Check out what happens on this episode of MG Road Trip!
